{{family name hatnote|[[Ni (surname)|Ni]]|lang=Chinese}}

'''Ni Weidou''' ({{zh|s=倪维斗|t=倪維斗|p=Ní Wéidòu}}; born October 6, 1932, in [[Zhenhai District|Zhenhai]], [[Ningbo]], [[Zhejiang]]) is a Chinese [[Mechanical engineering|mechanical]] and [[thermodynamics|thermodynamical]] [[scientist]] and [[engineer]].

==Career==
Ni's [[Ancestral home (China)|hometown]] is [[Zhenhai District]], [[Ningbo]], [[Zhejiang]] province. Ni entered [[Tsinghua University]] in 1951. Ni was transferred to the [[Bauman Moscow State Technical University]] of [[USSR]] and graduated in 1957. Ni obtained [[Candidate of Sciences]] degree (in 1962) and later honorary doctor degree (in 1990) from the [[Saint Petersburg Polytechnical University]].{{citation needed|date=October 2020}}

Ni is a [[professor]] at energy department of Tsinghua University. Ni was former Executive [[Vice-president]] of Tsinghua University.<ref>[http://www.tsinghua.edu.cn/chn/szdw/nwd.htm Ni Weidou's profile at Tsinghua University] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090607001358/http://www.tsinghua.edu.cn/chn/szdw/nwd.htm |date=2009-06-07 }}</ref>

Ni is a senior academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Engineering]]. Ni is the [[Vice-chairman]] of the Beijing Association for Science and Technology. Ni is also a leader and senior advisor of energy strategy,  technology, policy for Chinese government.<ref>[http://www.chinadialogue.net/author/show/112-Ni-Weidou 中外对话| China Dialogue | 倪维斗Ni Weidou]</ref>

==See also==
* [[Ni Wei-Tou]] (Ni Weidou) in [[Taiwan]], these two '''Ni'''s share the same name, the same hometown (Zhenhai District, Ningbo), and the same [[ancestry]]. And the Taiwanese Ni graduated from and works for the [[National Tsing Hua University]] (in [[Hsinchu]], Taiwan), which is the sister university (share the same root) of the [[Tsinghua University]] in [[Beijing]].
